    • tokenKey

      public GidAuthenticationConfig.Builder tokenKey(String tokenKey)
      Sets the token key from a Base64 URL-safe encoded string (RFC 4648 §5, alphabet A-Za-z0-9-_, padding optional).

      The given string MUST be valid Base64 URL encoded. Decoding happens immediately: if the string contains characters outside the Base64 URL alphabet (e.g. + or / from standard Base64), a GidClientConfigurationException is thrown right away, not deferred to build(). A null value is treated as an empty key and is rejected by build() as a missing value.

      Parameters:
      tokenKey - the Base64 URL encoded token key
      Returns:
      the builder instance
      Throws:
      GidClientConfigurationException - if tokenKey is not a valid Base64 URL encoded string

    • build
